title: Structure optimization of PL-B4 and PL-B8
action: Using the provided atomic structures of PL-B4 (space group Fd-3m (227), conventional lattice constant ~4.99 Å, primitive 3.53 Å, Wyckoff position 16d (0.625,0.125,0.125)) and PL-B8 (same space group, conventional 8.57 Å, primitive 6.06 Å, Wyckoff position 32e (0.570,0.070,0.070)), perform DFT geometry optimization to obtain relaxed primitive cell structures.
description: Relaxed structures are required as input for subsequent force-constant calculations.

title: Second-order force constants and phonon dispersion
action: From the relaxed primitive cells, create supercells and compute second-order interatomic force constants via finite displacements using phonopy coupled with DFT. Obtain phonon band structure and mode-resolved group velocities.
description: Second-order force constants and group velocities are needed for ShengBTE input and for branch-averaged velocity calculations.

title: Third-order force constants
action: Using the relaxed structures, create supercells, generate displaced configurations with thirdorder.py, and compute third-order force constants via DFT. Post-process to obtain anharmonic force constants suitable for ShengBTE.
description: Third-order force constants are required to compute three-phonon scattering rates and thermal conductivities.

title: Solve Boltzmann transport equation for PL-B4
action: Prepare ShengBTE input using the second- and third-order force constants of PL-B4. Run ShengBTE iteratively on a converged q-point mesh to obtain mode-resolved scattering rates, relaxation times, group velocities, and the lattice thermal conductivity tensor.
description: Raw scattering rates and thermal conductivity for PL-B4; needed for the scored branch-averaged properties.

title: Solve Boltzmann transport equation for PL-B8
action: Same as step_04 but for the PL-B8 structure.
description: Raw scattering rates and thermal conductivity for PL-B8; needed for the scored branch-averaged properties.

title: Branch-averaged properties for PL-B4
action: From the ShengBTE output and mode group velocities, compute the branch-averaged scattering rates (ps⁻¹) and group velocities (km/s) for phonon branches TA₁, TA₂, LA, and Optical; also extract the total lattice thermal conductivity at 300 K. Save these values in a JSON file.
description: JSON file containing the room-temperature thermal conductivity of PL-B4 and its branch-averaged scattering rates and group velocities.
output_schema: { thermal_conductivity_300K: number (W/mK), branch_averaged_scattering_rates: { TA1: number (ps⁻¹), TA2: number, LA: number, Optical: number }, branch_averaged_group_velocities: { TA1: number (km/s), TA2: number, LA: number, Optical: number } }

title: Branch-averaged properties for PL-B8
action: Same as step_06 but for PL-B8.
description: JSON file containing the room-temperature thermal conductivity of PL-B8 and its branch-averaged scattering rates and group velocities. (Optional secondary field for optical modes below the band gap may be included.)
output_schema: { thermal_conductivity_300K: number (W/mK), branch_averaged_scattering_rates: { TA1: number (ps⁻¹), TA2: number, LA: number, Optical: number }, branch_averaged_group_velocities: { TA1: number (km/s), TA2: number, LA: number, Optical: number } }
